intro: The global financial services, government, healthcare, and small business sectors faced significant risks from vulnerabilities between April 12 and May 3, 2026, with a severity mix of four medium, two high, and one critical issue. Key CVEs observed during this period include CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The United Kingdom was a notable region of concern alongside the global landscape.
